description: A chat's draft written (a change to the chat: Agent Management's write), kept by its host as the newest whatever was there (the last write wins), and told every other head attached to it (draft_changed). Sent a moment after typing stops, as the chat's left, and at once as the box is emptied by sending.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

text.description: What's written in its box now (empty: nothing, as once it's sent).

head.description: The box writing it, an id of the head's own pick (one each window or chat page): carried in the draft as it's told, so the box knows its own save.
